Checks effect script 28/27, sound 2 suppression, spell failure, lives, stock-only Bomb consumption via actual retail 412110, eight-frame deathbomb boundary, 30-frame loss/respawn, preserved fragments, 3-Bomb refill, 60-frame entry, fixed-point Y, exact SSE laser radii and circle/all cancellation arguments. th14-bullet-cancel.scope: Also compares actual 41b3f0 respawn circle: strict state 1/2, mandatory collision-delay filtering and ordered COMISS radius inclusion, including signed zero, NaN and infinity. Production GameBattle::cancel_bullets selects this TH14 path rather than legacy circle/erase-enemy/spell protection. Actual retail 41ae00 reward type 1 allocation, RNG, bounds, delay, pool exhaustion and subsequent item numerics are measured separately by th14-item-verified.json. Actual ECL 613 dispatch is checked through the production services/manager route with empty lasers, and 60 ECL 515 timer setters execute actual 4278e5/408b00. Secondary appearance VMs, lasers and GPU pixels remain unverified; ECL 615/616 still refuse nonempty laser lists.

th14-music-restore.scope: Retail 449e6c..449ea5 captures active filename and double playback time; 44aef0..44af2c requests the saved filename then the identical time. Controlled music-thread/device boundaries. Production AudioDevice uses actual miniaudio/Vorbis decoding and original-resource music files: all 18 tracks at two nonzero prefixes plus a stage-one loop-boundary case, result music between save/restore, exact decoder cursor and bit-identical next 1,024 stereo float PCM frames against uninterrupted playback. Pause/mute, discard and retry also checked. SDL device is a deterministic stub; excludes physical/queued audio timing, full Application transition execution, native DirectSound PCM equality and lossless original music. Existing OGG files are lossy; hashes pin these decoded inputs.
